                FROM pg_index i
                JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
                CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, i.indnkeyatts) AS k(position)
                WHERE i.indrelid = to_regclass(?)
                ORDER BY c.relname, k.position
